plainText:
Karin Nanami (Japanese: 奈波果林 Nanami Karin) is a Japanese voice actress for .

==Biography==
As an adult, Nanami became a voice actress and was involved with a few anime series. She became involved with the during , voicing Team Flare scientist Celosia as well as Lucianne, one of Baraz and Meray's childhood friends from Arche Valley. In addition, Nanami voiced , a character in Pokkén Tournament.
